observations: Input is a Python function wire_size(body) whose body line was changed to return len(body).
The stated behavior contract requires accepting str or bytes and returning wire byte count using UTF-8.
For str input, len(body) counts characters, not UTF-8 bytes, so it diverges from the contract for non-ASCII text.
Probe p1 passes the non-ASCII string '한글', where character count and UTF-8 byte count differ.
Probe p2 passes bytes b'AB', where len equals byte count and matches the contract.
Probe p3 passes an empty string, where len returns 0.
